in_english.name: Eimaanul
in_english.meaning: Faith in Allah and his messengers
in_english.long_meaning: Faith in Allah and his messengers and his religion is the foundation of Islam, and it is based on trust in Allah and his messengers. It involves accepting the Islamic creed and obeying Allah's commands and refraining from forbidden acts. Faith in Allah is the acceptance of the unity and uniqueness of Allah. Faith in the angels is the acceptance of the existence and role of angels in the universe. Faith in the books is the acceptance of the divine origin and authority of the Quran and other holy books. Faith in the messengers is the acceptance of the prophethood and message of the prophets. Faith in the Day of Judgment is the acceptance of the accountability and reckoning of human actions on the Day of Judgment.
